tspan.tspan: A special shape is asked for or a new product is being stud
ied, so a drawing is needed.
Opened from "Raise design request" on the quote. Trigger
= at quote and that quote are filled in.
Opened from "Raise design request" on the order line. Trig
ger = at order and that order line are filled in.
A request tied to neither a quote nor an order. It can also be
raised from New on the list, from the product master, or fro
m "No price list" on a quote.
Revision if the product × ordering-customer series already
has a version, otherwise New. It can be switched by hand.
Enter the version to start from (empty = latest) and the reas
on for the change (required).
A request number (DSG-) is assigned and it becomes Draft.
The assignee is notified. While in draft the content can be
edited.
It becomes Pending approval and the first-step approvers in
Approval settings (MS0B) are notified.
The status becomes Sent back.
Fix the content and press Request approval again.
Approved step by step; after the last step it becomes Not st
arted.
The assignee receives a "please start" notification.
Enter a reason and cancel. Possible from any status before
Completed; a pending approval request is withdrawn too. T
he flow ends here.
It becomes In progress and the requester is notified. Assig
nee and product can still be changed from the ⋯ menu.
Upload notes and drafts on the Files tab (optional). Only po
ssible while Not started or In progress.
Opened from "Register in Drawing" on the request, with pro
duct and ordering customer fixed to the request. A draft ver
sion is created with the next number of the series.
Only possible when at least one version came from this req
uest. It becomes Completed; the requester (and, at quote, t
he quote's sales rep) is notified.
Back to In progress and the completion date is cleared. Ap
proval is not taken again. The assignee is notified.
Register a new version and press Complete again. The earl
ier version stays.
Check the draft version and press Confirm or Request appro
val. Until confirmed, spec and files can be edited.
The version becomes Sent back.
Fix spec or files and press Request approval again.
After the steps set up for "Drawing version" in Approval set
tings it becomes Confirmed.
With no steps set up, one press of Confirm confirms it.
"Latest" of the series moves to this version. Other custom
ers' series are untouched. The product master reads its spe
c from this version.
Only confirmed versions can be chosen. Later revisions do
not change what the floor sees, and a pinned version can n
o longer be edited.
Latest version of the ordering customer's series, otherwise
of the generic series. Another customer's series is never u
sed.

svg.text: Design — from design request to registering the drawing
